## Physics conferences and schools

## General Physics

- [CERN Indico](https://indico.cern.ch/): A comprehensive platform for tracking recent and upcoming conferences in physics and related fields.
- [INFN School of Statistics](https://agenda.infn.it/event/36980/): A school focused on statistical methods in physics.

## High-Energy Physics Generators

- [GEN Tutorials-2024](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1360658/): Tutorials on HEP generators like MadGraph and Pythia.
  - [CMS MG5 Tutorial](https://cms-mg5-tutorial-2024-temp.docs.cern.ch/)
  - [Pythia Tutorials](https://gitlab.com/Pythia8/tutorials)

## Neutrino Physics

- [NuSTEC](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1331901/overview): A school focused on neutrino–nucleus interactions, including theoretical modeling, cross-section measurements, and Monte Carlo simulations.
  - Organized by NuSTEC, the Neutrino Scattering Theory Experiment Collaboration, to improve understanding of neutrino dynamics for large-scale experiments like DUNE and HyperKamiokande.
- [NuINT 24](https://indico.fnal.gov/event/59963/): Archive of the 14th workshop on neutrino–nucleus interactions, bringing theorists and experimentalists together.

## High-Energy Physics Computing and WLCG

- [HEPiX](https://www.hepix.org/): A forum for IT staff from HEP and nuclear physics labs to share knowledge about scientific computing and data challenges.
  - Includes semi-annual meetings with participation from major labs like CERN, FNAL, DESY, and others.
